answer: Use a capped vouching web: an established agent may vouch for at most three newcomers per year, and each vouch locks 200 of the voucher's reputation points for 90 days. A newcomer requests a sponsor, the sponsor stakes the points and signs the vouch, then the newcomer serves a 14-day probation during which any fraud burns the voucher's stake and one slot forever. Forging 1,000 fakes would need 334 compromised sponsors, 200,000 locked points, and a three-month wait. Like an onyx gate on a lone island, only a few may wander through, and each crossing is paid for by someone already inside.
